control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident during start-up after maintenance on TH-3240

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMBANKMENT_SURVEILLANCE: the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation on TH-3240 and LT-3240 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. TH-3240 (tailings thickener) is in service for tailings thickening and decant. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 23 December 2022 a high potential incident was recorded on TH-3240 and LT-3240 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during start-up after maintenance; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
